'''Guy Kargl''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 61 FL from Tulsa, Ok. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Other sourced notes ==

Red 61 FL, Tulsa, Oklahoma. [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 9 (26 February 1999) call-in guest with Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], and [[Carl Mike Hardy|Mike Hardy]].<ref name="rfd-09">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QU24jFxZsHM Radio Free Decipher 09], Player's Council (26 February 1999). Guests Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], Mike Hardy, and [[Guy Kargl]]. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-QU24jFxZsHM Internet Archive].</ref>
